verse.verse_1: Beholdest thou him who belieth the Requital?
verse.verse_2: It is he who pusheth away the orphan,
verse.verse_3: And urgeth not the feeding of the poor,
verse.verse_4: Woe, therefore, Unto such performers of prayer.
verse.verse_5: As are of their prayer careless.
verse.verse_7: And who withholds even common necessaries.
